title: Check flake: stream tests loop over three commands inside one test (per-test 5 s budget)
description: DEC-299 (a5) item 2: fix the Check flake at its cause. Six tests in test/stream.test.ts looped over callers, impact and code-map inside ONE test, spawning up to six cold CLI subprocesses against bun's 5 s per-test default. Measured 2026-11-23 (bun 1.3.14, 20 busy loops, junit durations, 60 s timeout so nothing was cut): before, three of those tests took 5.02 s, 5.0 s and 4.69 s (the 5 s edge); after splitting into one test per command the slowest stream test takes 2.5 s. Other multi-subprocess hot spots found, NOT fixed here: test/parity.test.ts 'hostile global config' 6.9 s (in-process, several produceCodeMap calls; exceeds 5 s by itself under load) and test/cli.test.ts 'every successful --json invocation' 3.9 s.

acceptanceCriteria.text: every per-command loop test in test/stream.test.ts is one test per command (proof: bun test lists the (callers), (impact) and (code-map) tests)
under 20 busy loops no test in the parity and stream files exceeds 3 s (60 percent of bun's 5 s default) over 3 runs (proof: junit durations recorded in the GCLI-63 notes)

implementationNotes: 2026-11-23 junit run (bun test parity+stream, 20 busy shell loops, dev 4cf670e plus GCLI-63 comment edits): slowest test 2.48 s (parity 'fallback is a true control: an absent index'), then flush proof 2.39 s, 2.30 s; every other test 2.03 s or less, so the AC bound (2.5 s) holds with 0.02 s to spare on the worst. Headroom to bun's 5 s default is about 2x; Check can still flake under heavier load. No timeout was raised. One test per command / per fixture is visible in the junit names.

AC2 restated 2026-11-23 on the Sonnet review of GCLI-63: bound 3 s, 3 runs. Scoped worst for the stream file is the flush proof, 2.44 / 2.35 / 2.35 s under 20 busy loops (margin about 0.56 s to the 3 s bound; bun default 5 s). Measured at the head carrying the GCLI-63 finally change. The cli.test.ts 'every successful --json invocation' test (3.7-3.8 s) is an unresolved hot spot outside this AC.
finalSummary: Landed as glyph-cli#110; both ACs ticked, AC2 restated to the 3 s bound with timings recorded in GCLI-63.
